digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions mirror CI for main branch
propositions: Gerrit-primary projects using GitHub as a read-only mirror experience cancelled CI runs rendering as red X on a healthy main because push-triggered jobs with concurrency groups cancel prior runs
Switching main-branch CI from push-triggered to schedule-only (every 6 hours at staggered off-the-hour minutes) eliminates cancelled-run red X's by construction without adding per-commit overhead
Pre-merge gating remains unaffected because gerrit-verify.yaml and pre-merge reusables are unchanged; the safety-net policy changes only when scheduled main CI runs, not what gates merges

Scheduled multi-commit batches require automated bisection support: last-known-green SHA from Actions API run history, git bisect run reproduction recipe, and graceful degradation when that lookup fails
